description.en:
Tells whether a character is part of the player's match team: the first 16 places of the team order (11 starters and 5 substitutes), or fewer if the roster is smaller.
The story events use it before a match to check that the characters the scene needs are in the team.
Read but not used. The shipped scripts pass 0.
Player parameter ID to look for, e.g. "para_cp0008".

true if the character is in those first 16 places, false otherwise.
null if the engine is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.

examples.case: Checking that two story characters are in the team (real usage, from ev42022000.nut)
